name: Ako's Treasure: Location 1
desc: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the first part.

desc.text:
This picture was left behind by Ako Domeki and company.
The secret of where the treasure is hidden... It was split into four parts and placed amidst the reefs of the four large islands, and this is the first part.
Make a circle with a radius eighteen large boat-lengths long with this place as its center...
The treasure is hidden where the four circles meet.
